pages.title: Backpacks on Board
pages.text: Hold a backpack and sneak-use an empty cargo slot to load it. Use a loaded backpack to open its own storage screen, even while holding another item.$(br2)Sneak-use it to unload into your inventory. If your inventory is full, it drops beside the wagon.

pages.title: Keeping Your Supplies
pages.text: Stored items and backpack settings are kept when you unload or convert the wagon.$(br2)With Carry On installed, its permitted pickup gesture takes priority. Otherwise, sneak-use returns the backpack as an item. Use Carry On’s configured key if you have changed it.

pages.title: Sleeping Bags
pages.text: A separate sleeping bag uses two consecutive slots in one column. Use an empty slot while holding it: the second slot is chosen $(bold)away from you$(reset), toward either the front or rear.$(br2)Both slots must be empty. The complete sleeping bag is scaled evenly between them.

pages.title: A Night on the Wagon
pages.text: Stop and steady the wagon, then use either half of the sleeping bag to sleep. Players keep their existing respawn point and stay asleep when the wagon moves.$(br2)Use it in a bed-compatible dimension under normal sleeping conditions. For maid passengers, provide wagon straw mats. Sneak-use either half to unload the bag.
